solutions.title: Fire Protection Paint
solutions.description: Intumescent coatings for the protection of steel structures — invisible protection that expands in a fire and preserves load-bearing capacity.
solutions.fullDescription:
Fire protection paints and coatings are the most elegant way to protect steel structures. Under normal conditions they look like an ordinary finishing coat, and in the event of fire they expand and form an insulating layer that protects the steel from losing its load-bearing capacity.

Our services include:

- Selection of the appropriate coating system according to the required resistance (R 30 – R 120)
- Machine application of the coating (airless)
- Dry film thickness control and execution records
- Decorative top coats in the desired colour

We work with proven systems from Promat and Rudolf Hensel, adapting the execution to the structural profile, ambient conditions and project requirements.

specifications.application: Steel structures — industrial halls, sports halls, office buildings

solutions.title: Fire-Rated Doors and Metalwork
solutions.description: Our own product under the FSB Doors brand — fire doors, partitions and access panels, from production to installation.
solutions.fullDescription:
Fire-rated doors and metalwork are our own product — we develop and manufacture them under the FSB Doors brand, certify them to European standards and install them with our own crews.

From our range:

- Single-leaf and double-leaf fire doors (EI 30 – EI 90)
- Fire doors for tunnels and infrastructure facilities
- Access panels and technical doors
- Doors with glazing and panic hardware

Because we know the product from the very first drawing, we can guarantee correct installation and function — because a door only protects if it is correctly installed.

specifications.application: Buildings of all types, tunnels, industry

solutions.title: Firestopping
solutions.description: Sealing of cable, pipe and ventilation penetrations through fire compartment walls — the detail the entire system depends on.
solutions.fullDescription:
Every service penetration through a fire compartment wall is a potential path for fire spread. Firestopping restores the wall's full fire resistance — and it is precisely these details that cause the most problems in practice.

We seal all types of penetrations:

- Cable trays and individual cables
- Combustible and non-combustible pipes (collars, wraps, sealants)
- Mixed penetrations
- Expansion and construction joints

We use certified systems (Promat, Rudolf Hensel) and document every position — labelling, records and reports are part of our standard delivery.

specifications.application: Service penetrations through fire compartment walls

solutions.title: Fire-Rated Glazing
solutions.description: Fire-resistant glazed partitions and glazing — transparency and safety in one.
solutions.fullDescription:
Fire-rated glazing allows natural light and visual connection between spaces without compromising fire safety. We install it in partitions, doors and facade positions.

Our solutions include:

- Fire-rated glazed partitions (EI 30 – EI 90)
- Glazing in fire-rated doors and metalwork
- Large glazed surfaces in atriums and circulation areas
- Combinations with smoke seals and panic hardware

From system selection and structural analysis to installation and handover documentation — everything is carried out by a single team, because all systems must work as a whole.

specifications.application: Glazed partitions, atriums, circulation areas, facades

solutions.title: Fire Protection Cladding
solutions.description: Cladding of steel and concrete structures, ducts and cable routes with fire protection boards.
solutions.fullDescription:
Board cladding is a classic and exceptionally reliable solution for protecting structures. It is used wherever high fire resistance, mechanical strength or retrofit protection of existing elements is required.

We install cladding for:

- Steel columns and beams (up to R 240)
- Ventilation and smoke extraction ducts
- Cable routes and service shafts
- Self-supporting fire compartment walls

We work with calcium silicate boards (PROMATECT and related systems), with complete supporting documentation of the installed materials and executed details.

specifications.application: Structures, ducts, cable routes, compartment walls

solutions.title: Fire-Rated Spandrel
solutions.description: Our own developed solution for fire separation between floors at the facade — prevents vertical fire spread.
solutions.fullDescription:
A fire-rated spandrel prevents fire from spreading from floor to floor across the facade — a detail that is decisive for the safety of the entire building with modern glazed facades.

Our spandrel solution:

- Developed by our in-house R&D team and tested in accredited laboratories
- A system of subconstruction, stone wool and fire protection boards
- Adapted to any facade geometry
- Installed by our own certified crews

As manufacturer and installer in one, we take full responsibility for the spandrel — from the workshop drawing to the installation report.
